subject.title: feat(android): pair multiple gateways and switch between them without re-pairing

question: Should maintainers accept this Android-first multi-gateway implementation after proof/CI gates clear, or require a coordinated iOS/Android registry design before any official mobile multi-gateway support lands?
rationale: The patch is app-owned and matches the canonical feature issue, but it defines persistent credential, trust, notification, chat/session, and mobile UX semantics that automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue Android Slice After Gates
options.body: Fix the exact-head validation gap, add real Android upgrade/switch/forget proof, and let maintainers review the storage and security model before merge.

options.title: Require Coordinated Mobile Design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define shared iOS and Android registry, active-gateway, credential, and device-integration semantics.

options.title: Defer Official Multi-Gateway Mobile
options.body: Keep the linked feature open but do not land first-class mobile gateway switching until the product priority is confirmed later.

recommendation.title: Continue Android Slice After Gates
recommendation.body: Fix the exact-head validation gap, add real Android upgrade/switch/forget proof, and let maintainers review the storage and security model before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the canonical feature issue and has the strongest recent history across the Android gateway, settings, and security-adjacent surfaces touched by this PR.
